question: What should one make in solitude while intent on meditation?
premises: ekānte bahudhā rūpaṃ kuru means make form in many ways in solitude
dhyānañ ca tatparaḥ means and meditation intent on that
inference: In solitude, one should make form in many ways, being intent on meditation.
uncertainties: whether tatparaḥ modifies kuru or dhyāna
plain_english: In solitude, make form in many ways, being intent on meditation.
